name: Packed Vertex Attribute Encoding
aliases: Packed Vertex Packing with Ambient Occlusion
definition: A compression scheme for vertex attributes in hardware-accelerated volume splatting that reduces memory usage by packing volume texture coordinates and Gaussian texture coordinates into 32-bit integers per vertex.
summary: Packed Vertex Attribute Encoding compresses volume and Gaussian texture coordinates into 32-bit integers for hardware-accelerated volume splatting, achieving high compression ratios by decoupling components into fixed-width bit fields.
